# Agent Action Guard

> Open-source runtime safety screening for proposed AI-agent tool actions. The Python and JavaScript packages help applications classify actions before execution; use layered authorization, sandboxing, and approval for high-impact operations.

The HTML pages below are canonical. Their Markdown counterparts provide equivalent readable content for AI assistants, retrieval systems, and text-only browsing; every Markdown page links back to its HTML source.

## Website and documentation — HTML and Markdown

- [Agent Action Guard home — HTML](https://action-guard.pro-genai.com/) | [Markdown](https://action-guard.pro-genai.com/index.md) — Classify proposed agent tool calls with a lightweight Python and JavaScript runtime, local inference, and native pre-tool-use hooks.
- [Documentation — HTML](https://action-guard.pro-genai.com/docs/) | [Markdown](https://action-guard.pro-genai.com/docs/index.md) — Official Agent Action Guard documentation: install the Python or JavaScript package, screen AI agent tool calls, configure embedding backends, integrations, hooks, CLI, and HTTP API.

## Code and installation resources

- [Source repository](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/Agent-Action-Guard): Agent Action Guard source, examples, tests, and benchmark artifacts.
- [README](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/Agent-Action-Guard/blob/main/README.md): Project overview and benchmark context.
- [Usage guide](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/Agent-Action-Guard/blob/main/USAGE.md): Installation, embedding backends, API usage, and hooks.
- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/Pro-GenAI/Agent-Action-Guard/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Repository navigation for coding agents.
- [Python package](https://pypi.org/project/agent-action-guard/): Install with `pip install agent-action-guard`.

## Integration notes for AI assistants

- Python: `from agent_action_guard import is_action_harmful`, then classify a structured action just before tool execution.
- JavaScript: `isActionHarmful()` and `ensureActionSafety()` support Node.js agent loops.
- Pre-tool-use hook targets: `codex`, `claude-code`, `cursor`, `kiro`, `opencode`, `agy`, `copilot`, `openclaw`, and `hermes`.
- Install a native hook with `agent-action-guard hooks install --target <target>`.
- Embedding options and default ONNX caching are documented on the [HTML docs](https://action-guard.pro-genai.com/docs/) and in [Markdown](https://action-guard.pro-genai.com/docs/index.md).
- A safety classifier is not a substitute for access control, input validation, least privilege, or human review.
